label: The serial algorithm
subgoals: Simulate the fault-free circuit once per pattern
Simulate each faulty circuit on the patterns and compare outputs
Count one run per fault per pattern

label: Fault dropping
subgoals: Charge a detected fault the runs up to its first detection
Charge an undetected fault every pattern
Sum the per-fault costs and compare with faults times patterns

label: Coverage as a by-product
subgoals: Count the faults first detected at or before pattern k
Divide by the total faults for the coverage after k patterns
Disable dropping for diagnosis and n-detect
